Travel is Euclidean distance from queue_end_position to task location divided by speed. Execution duration is workload divided by its proficiency for required_skill (floor 0.05). Estimate the duration from now until this task completes, including waiting, travel and execution. Use only the supplied state. End your response with the answer as a JSON object on its own final line: {"bid": nonnegative number}.
